title: Towards On-Board Implementation of ML-Based Helicopter Weight Estimator
abstract: arXiv:2608.19210v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper focuses on the implementation of a novel supervised Machine Learning model for estimating helicopter weight during takeoff, utilizing extensive datasets from Airbus's global in-service fleet. The study details a learning assurance process aligned with the EASA concept paper for machine learning application, and with the on-going Eurocae ED-324. We propose a set of Machine Learning Requirements, a Machine Learning Model Description, and its implementation for a long short-term memory recurrent neural network. Finally, we verify the requirements on the implementation. Demonstrated on legacy avionics computers, the implementation is suitable for the deployment of the developed Machine Learning Model weight estimator on airborne targets for critical functions such as on-board alerting.

translated_title: 面向机载实现的基于机器学习的直升机重量估算器
translated_abstract: 本文聚焦于一种新型监督机器学习模型的实现，用于估算直升机起飞时的重量，该模型利用空中客车全球在役机队的大量数据集。研究详细描述了一个符合EASA机器学习应用概念文件和正在进行的Eurocae ED-324标准的学习保证过程。我们提出了一套机器学习需求、机器学习模型描述，以及其长短期记忆递归神经网络的实现。最后，我们在实现上验证了这些需求。在传统航空电子计算机上展示，该实现适用于将开发的机器学习模型重量估算器部署到机载目标上，用于如机载警报等关键功能。
tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种基于LSTM的机器学习模型，用于在传统航空电子设备上实现直升机起飞重量估算，满足航空安全标准，适用于机载关键功能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and validates an LSTM-based machine learning model for helicopter takeoff weight estimation on legacy avionics, meeting aviation safety standards and suitable for onboard critical functions.
